paint_station.name: Paint the wood / tins, stains and timber panels
paint_station.description: Six of the kit's one-metre timber panels on an easel wall, six tins of emulsion (red, yellow, blue, white, black, pink) and three jars of stain (cyan, magenta, yellow) on a bench. Hold a tin or a jar, aim at a panel, pull the trigger: one coat. Emulsion lays its colour over what is there (one coat 70 %, so the grain shows; two 91 %); stain filters everything beneath it, so cyan over yellow is green. Mixed in linear light. SAND returns every panel to bare wood; the panels stay carryable.
paint_station.qfep_connection: Two ways a colour can sit on a surface: laid over what is there, or filtering what lies beneath. The wood stays in the picture until it is covered.
